skills.name: signal-push
skills.description: Push a trading signal (token, direction, entry/SL/TP) to a peer's agent via the Susurration whisper network

skills.name: signal-react
skills.description: React +1 (agree) or -1 (disagree) to a peer's trading signal with conviction sizing

skills.name: signal-feed
skills.description: Read cross-channel feed of trading signals from all connected peers

skills.name: friends-manage
skills.description: Add, accept, or remove peer connections in the whisper network

skills.name: channel-manage
skills.description: Create group channels (2-10 members), invite, kick, transfer ownership

skills.name: paper-trading
skills.description: View paper trading positions and P&L from autonomous daemon reactions
